messages:
Priya Singh: FYI were running an A/B price-sheet sweep tomorrow 09:30 PT for two waves (partners + beta). Need final signoff on grandfathering rules and vendor mapping.
Owen Murray: Which wave sequencing? partners first or beta?
Priya Singh: Partners wave at 09:30, beta wave at 11:00. Stagger so CS can handle support load.
Noah Rivera: I noticed vendor_mapping.csv has duplicate vendor_id for 'acme-ai' with different rate ids. Could cause wrong baseline.
Owen Murray: @Noah can you patch and re-upload? also send to billing-bot to regen previews.
Noah Rivera: Fixed duplicate, normalized to vendor_id=acme-ai-01 and uploaded to /sheets/vendor_mapping_2024-03.csv
billing-bot: [automated] Preview regen requested -> preview_id=prv_20240320_abseq
billing-bot: [automated] Invoice preview available: https://redwood.internal/preview/prv_20240320_abseq
Priya Singh: Grandfather rules: apply only to monthly subscriptions created before 2023-10-01 and using promo=legacy_beta. Exclude annual contracts and any account with manual_credit_flag=true. No retro billing edits.
Ana Gomez: Finance note: refunds will be manual credits only. Auto-refunds disabled for canary. Escalation: finance-ops@redwood for >$200 credits.
Owen Murray: Ops checklist: set grandfather_flag=true on elig accounts; holdback 30% traffic for first 24h; lock pricing.toml at 09:00 PT.
Noah Rivera: Dashboard updated: /dashboards/pricing/ab_sequenced. Alerts: avg_invoice_delta>$40 OR pct_impacted>2.5% -> page finance-oncall.
Priya Singh: Rollback plan: immediate rollback of routing to legacy price sheet + run manual invoice revocation job. Manual credit runbook: /runbooks/pricing/credit_revoke.md.
Ana Gomez: Approved for canary with holdback. Approval ID FA-2024-0320. Note: require CS canned message before beta wave.
Owen Murray: I'll draft the CS message: short explanation + escalation steps. Will post to #customer-success 30m before beta wave.
Priya Singh: Post-run tasks: reconcile preview vs generated invoices, create ticket if any single-account delta >$300. Tag: billing/ops and CS.
Noah Rivera: I'll run a quick sanity diff script after wave 1 and report top-5 differences.
billing-bot: [automated] Scheduled job queued: job_id=job_2155004500 run_at=2024-03-20T16:30:00Z
Ana Gomez: Keep hourly check-ins in this thread for 3h post-deploy. If anything anomalous, escalate to exec-ops.
Priya Singh: Thanks all. Final checklist: vendor mapping fixed 705, preview generated 705, finance approval FA-2024-0320 705. Wave 1 go at 09:30 PT.
